title: Pirc Defense: 150 Attack
line: White brings the bishop and the queen out together to attack; Black takes space on the queen's side and hits the center.

steps.text: Here White brings the bishop to e3, ready to bring the queen out behind it.
Push the pawn on c7 one square. It gets ready to push the pawn on b7.

also.f8g7: That also works. This lesson pushes the side pawn first.
also.a7a6: That also works. This lesson goes on with the other side pawn.

steps.text: Push the pawn on b7 two squares. It takes space on the queen's side.
Bring the knight to d7. It backs up a pawn push to e5.

also.f8g7: That also works. This lesson brings the knight out first.

steps.text: Strike at the center: push the pawn on e7 two squares.

also.d8c7: That also works. This lesson strikes at the center now.
also.f8g7: That also works. This lesson strikes at the center now.

steps.after: Your pawns hold space on the queen's side and hit the center, and your king can still choose where to go.

summary: Against the 150 Attack, Black takes space on the queen's side and then strikes at the center.
